findings.title: ci-local gate 2 is RED at the reviewed sha: settings tests race on a shared temp path under Odin's parallel @(test) runner (10/10 full-suite failures locally)
findings.detail: Non-atomic package counter + os.remove + shared path: concurrent tests collide (log shows 5 tests on test-8 one run, test-5/test-7 another). Full `odin test app` failed 10/10 runs; isolated reruns pass. The 13th test (r3 push) moved the schedule to always-collide. PR's '10/10' claim is false at this sha; the merge ground-truth gate is broken.
findings.recommended_fix: Unique path per call without shared state (temp dir + os.process_id-ish + a per-call counter seeded from t's own identity, or os.create_temp_directory per test), or mark the suite single-threaded. Land a repeat-run leg (loop the binary N times in gate 2).

findings.title: UI-swallowed left presses fall through to the world path — tray intents and Begin_Draw fire on presses the popover/QoS panel/banner already swallowed (regression vs base v2)
findings.detail: Base v2 gated the whole world path on `if ui {} else {}`. The 7.3 rework split the chain: only panel_open suppresses; a press swallowed by the QoS panel/crisis banner/SLA rows/popover (ui=true, panel closed) still runs tray hit-tests and node snap → Begin_Draw. The in-code comment still claims 'a panel click never deselects, never starts a drag'.
findings.recommended_fix: Restore the ui gate over the world path: `if ui { swallowed } else if !panel_open { tray/node/draw }` — the modal block is then unreachable when ui swallowed, matching base semantics.
